youtube.title: Hunyuan3D: 3 lamps, 55 free seconds, 1 shattered
youtube.description:
Unpaid. No affiliate link, and Tencent did not pay for this test.

Specimen Nº002: Hunyuan3D 2.1 on Tencent's official Hugging Face Space, logged out. One run per photo, default settings: three desk lamps, about 20 seconds each, 55 of the 120 free GPU seconds a logged-out visitor gets per day.
Captured: two lamps came back as clean, one-piece shapes. Honest flaw: the chrome lamp shattered into six loose pieces. Textured models were refused without a login (they ask for more GPU time than the free quota allows).

Free tier: 2 GPU minutes a day logged out (shapes only). Paid from: $9 a month (Hugging Face PRO, 8× the GPU quota).
Field notes, sources and the test conditions: https://specimindlab.github.io/002?from=yt

Lamp photos: Roger Bradshaw, Andrej Lišakov and Aashish Chandra on Unsplash.
Licence note: Hunyuan3D 2.1's community licence excludes the EU, UK and South Korea.

#ai3d #3dmodeling #specimindlab
